zh.title: 法航安局重現夜航調查尼斯跑道誤降事件
zh.summary: 法BEA重現夜飛行調查尼斯跑道燈光影響；尼韋爾航班誤降04R跑道致近撞
body: 法國民航安全調查分析局（BEA）於2026年9月21日發布更新，繼續調查2025年9月21日晚間在尼斯蔚藍海岸機場（NCE）發生的嚴重事件。當時尼韋爾航空（Nouvelair）一架空中巴士A320-200（ICAO機型代碼A320）獲准降落04L跑道，卻誤降至04R跑道，該跑道上有易捷航空（easyJet）一架同機型客機停放待飛，兩機曾極度接近。
根據BEA 2025年10月初步報告，尼韋爾航班無線電高度在1秒內從39英尺驟降至10英尺，隨後1秒上升至24英尺並執行復飛。事發時間約為2025年9月21日晚間21時30分，機組確認獲准降落04L跑道，但實際進場至04R跑道。
為釐清跑道燈光對進場影響，BEA於2026年1月協同法國航導服務、尼斯機場營運商及易捷航空（提供機組與飛機），請衛爾國家憲兵隊航空分隊（SAG）執行夜間重現飛行。民航技術局（STAC）同步分析跑道燈光特性及其感知影響，並審視歐洲機場燈光法規、檢查程序及尼斯機場過往跑道混淆案例。
BEA指出調查已發現若干改善方向：機組對機場特性的認知、機場燈光法規要求及檢查方法（地面與飛行）、先進地面活動制導管制系統（A-SMGCS）的使用、法國航行服務總局（DSNA）處理安全事件的方式。這些項目可能隨後續工作演進。
BEA強調調查仍在持續，旨在鞏固發現、識別促成因素，並視情況提出安全建議或安全通報以防類似事件再發生。

en.title: French BEA Reenacts Night Flight to Probe Nice Runway Confusion Incident
en.summary: French BEA reenacts night flight to assess Nice runway lighting impact; Nouvelair A320 landed on wrong runway
body: The French Bureau of Enquiry and Analysis for Civil Aviation Safety (BEA) issued an update on 21 September 2026 regarding its investigation into a serious incident that occurred on 21 September 2025 at Nice Côte d'Azur Airport (NCE). A Nouvelair Airbus A320-200 (ICAO type code A320), cleared to land on runway 04L, instead lined up for runway 04R where an easyJet A320-200 was stopped and aligned with the centreline.

According to the BEA's October 2025 preliminary report, the Nouvelair aircraft's radio altitude dropped from 39 ft to 10 ft in one second before rising to 24 ft in the next second, prompting a go-around. The flight crew had confirmed the clearance for runway 04L at around 21:30 local time but proceeded to runway 04R.

To examine the influence of runway lighting on the approaches, the BEA conducted a night flight reenactment in January 2026 in coordination with French air navigation services, the Nice airport operator, and easyJet, which supplied a crew and aircraft. The Hyères Gendarmerie Air Section (SAG) helicopter unit performed the reenactment. The Service Technique de l'aviation Civile (STAC) analysed the runway lighting characteristics and their perceptual impact. Additional work covered European aerodrome lighting regulations, inspection procedures, and previous runway confusion occurrences at Nice.

The BEA stated the investigation had notably shown possibilities of improvement concerning: crews' knowledge of certain aerodrome specificities; regulatory requirements for aerodrome lighting and the methods for checking such lighting (on the ground and in flight); use of the Advanced Surface Movement Guidance and Control System (A-SMGCS); and the Direction des Services de la Navigation Aérienne's (DSNA) handling of safety occurrences. These points may evolve as work progresses.
The investigation continues to consolidate findings, identify contributing factors, and, where appropriate, issue safety recommendations or safety messages to prevent recurrence.

facts.claim: BEA issued an update on 21 September 2026 on its investigation into the serious incident where a Nouvelair A320 flew closely over an easyJet A320 stopped on runway 04R at Nice Côte d'Azur Airport.
facts.sourceQuote: On September 21, 2026, the BEA issued an update on its investigation into the events that led to the Nouvelair A320 flying closely over an easyJet A320 that was “stopped and aligned with the centerline of runway 04R” at Nice Côte d’Azur Airport (NCE).

facts.claim: The incident occurred on 21 September 2025 around 21:30; the Nouvelair crew had been cleared to land on runway 04L but landed on runway 04R.
